effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 3 of 5 is on now: Team C (Neito Monoma and Sen Kaibara) as heroes against Team D (Yosetsu Awase and Kojiro Bondo) as villains. Only Yosetsu Awase and Kojiro Bondo are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams E, F, A, B. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team G (Juzo Honenuki and Jurota Shishida) against Team H (Hiryu Rin and Yui Kodai); Teams E, F, A, B, C, D are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 2 more rounds remain. If the story sums up the rest of the trial in one turn, the remaining rounds are exactly: 4. Honenuki/Shishida vs Rin/Kodai; 5. Shoda/Tsuburaba vs Kuroiro/Fukidashi. Nobody else fights. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
